name: keystroke-capture
description: Captures in-editor keystroke and edit events with high-resolution timing for typing-behavior research. Local storage only, no network.

keystrokeCapture.autoStart.description: Begin recording automatically when VS Code starts. When false, recording is off until you start it.

keystrokeCapture.storagePath.description: Absolute folder path for capture files. Leave empty to use the extension's global storage folder.

enumDescriptions: Record the actual character/text that was typed.
Record only the key category (letter, digit, whitespace, punctuation, control) — never the literal character.
Record a salted hash of each character — preserves repeat/n-gram structure without storing readable text.
keystrokeCapture.capturePolicy.description: How much of the typed content to record. Use 'categoryOnly' or 'hashed' when studying timing without needing readable content.

keystrokeCapture.captureDocumentChanges.description: Record document edit events (insertions, deletions, paste, autocomplete, multi-cursor) in addition to raw keystrokes.

keystrokeCapture.captureSelectionChanges.description: Record cursor/selection movement events. Increases data volume substantially.

keystrokeCapture.excludeFilePattern.description: Glob-like substring; if a file path contains it, that file's events are not recorded (e.g. 'secret' or '.env').

keystrokeCapture.flushIntervalMs.description: How often buffered events are written to disk, in milliseconds.

scripts.lint: echo "No build step: extension.js runs directly."
